about.heading: A developer who cares about the details
about.whoIAm: I'm Abdul Samad, a passionate Cloud Data Engineering student and Full Stack Developer. I design and build clean, modern and high-performance web applications using TypeScript, Node.js and Express. My focus is on writing maintainable code, delivering exceptional user experiences and following accessibility and performance best practices on every project.
about.myJourney: My journey started in 2024 with Microsoft Word — my very first computer skill — and grew step by step into web development, full stack engineering and finally cloud data engineering. Every stage has been built through hands-on practice, real projects and continuous study.
about.myGoals: My goal is to become a world-class engineer who bridges the gap between data engineering and full stack development — building intelligent, scalable systems that solve real-world problems. I'm always exploring new technologies and I'm open to internships, freelance work and exciting collaborations.

journey.title: First Steps with MS Word
journey.description: My tech journey began with Microsoft Word — mastering documents, formatting and keyboard shortcuts sparked my curiosity about computers and software.

journey.title: Discovered Programming
journey.description: Wrote my first lines of HTML, CSS and JavaScript and fell in love with building things for the web.

journey.title: Full Stack Development
journey.description: Built my first complete projects — a furniture e-commerce platform and a weather dashboard — mastering Node.js, Express, TypeScript and React along the way.

journey.title: Real-World & Open Source
journey.description: Shipped production-quality applications, contributed to open source and sharpened my engineering discipline through hands-on practice.

journey.title: Cloud Data Engineering
journey.description: Currently studying cloud data engineering — data pipelines, ETL, cloud platforms like AWS and Azure, and Linux — building toward a career as a cloud data engineer.

skills.heading: Technologies I work with every day
skills.description: A practical, hands-on toolkit built through real projects — from pixel-perfect frontends to scalable Node.js backends and cloud data workflows.
